school_name: Missouri University of Science and Technology
title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Ten documented components of Missouri S&T’s student-led Best Ever St. Pat’s celebration in Rolla.

cards.title: The “Best Ever” St. Pat’s
cards.subtitle: Missouri S&T’s annual St. Patrick’s tradition
cards.notes: Use the official St. Pat’s page to follow the current season’s events and learn how this 1908 celebration grew around campus and Rolla.
cards.short_summary: Missouri S&T’s defining St. Patrick’s celebration dates to 1908.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T identifies St. Pat’s as its most enduring and defining tradition; the celebration began in 1908.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: A multi-event celebration; consult the official event listings for current participation details.

cards.title: Drive the snakes out of Rolla
cards.subtitle: Opening St. Pat’s ritual outside Toomey and Parker halls
cards.notes: See the fenced snake pits during St. Pat’s opening events, where participants answer tradition questions and use plastic snakes in the ritual.
cards.short_summary: A campus opening ritual centered on symbolic plastic snakes.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T describes Snake Invasion as the first St. Pat’s event, held outside Toomey and Parker halls.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Follow current St. Pat’s event guidance and staff instructions at the snake pits.

cards.title: Paint Pine Street green
cards.subtitle: St. Pat’s parade-day tradition in downtown Rolla
cards.notes: Look for the green-painted Pine Street on parade day; the official history says St. Pat’s Board alumni handle the early-morning painting.
cards.short_summary: Alumni paint the parade route green before the Rolla procession.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T states that St. Pat’s Board alumni paint Pine Street green from end to end before the annual parade.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Observe from public areas and respect parade-day street closures and event staff directions.

cards.title: Follow the green parade downtown
cards.subtitle: Annual procession on Pine Street, Rolla
cards.notes: Check the official schedule for the parade date, then watch the Court of St. Patrick, campus groups and local businesses move along Pine Street.
cards.short_summary: The celebration’s downtown procession features the Court and community groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T says the annual parade is held on Pine Street and is led by the Court of St. Patrick.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Use the current official schedule and local traffic guidance for viewing locations.

cards.title: Meet the Court at Coronation
cards.subtitle: Court of St. Patrick ceremony, typically at Leach Theatre
cards.notes: Consult the current St. Pat’s schedule for this court ceremony, which recognizes honorary knights and knights student queens and knights.

cards.evidence_claim: Missouri S&T describes Coronation as honoring the Court of St. Patrick and the year’s eight honorary knights.
cards.source_title: St. Pat’s – Student Involvement | Missouri S&T
cards.access_notes: Typically held at Leach Theatre; verify the venue and attendance details in the current schedule.
